

# Content Domain 2: Design Resilient Widget Stores
<a name="widget-architect-domain2"></a>

**Topics**
+ [Task 2.1: Design scalable widget storage](#widget-architect-domain2-task1)
+ [Task 2.2: Design widget storage for more than one Region](#widget-architect-domain2-task2)

## Task 2.1: Design scalable widget storage
<a name="widget-architect-domain2-task1"></a>

Knowledge of:
+ Shelf capacity and quotas (for example, widgets per shelf, shelves per Region)
+ Storage types and their use cases (for example, shelves, crates)

Skills in:
+ Determining the number of shelves that a workload needs
+ Selecting a shelf or a crate based on requirements

## Task 2.2: Design widget storage for more than one Region
<a name="widget-architect-domain2-task2"></a>

Knowledge of:
+ The Regional scope of a shelf

Skills in:
+ Copying a shelf to another Region
